purpose: User-requested return to legible procedural room backgrounds with a clear central ABO product. Fix room geometry, window, tabletop and lighting; background edits change only one wall palette. Product substitution specifies only one broad family; joint requests this family and one wall palette. No generated photographic room assets or complex multi-part product descriptions.
diversity: Each literal TRAIN object instruction covers multiple target product identities (at least3), balanced across distinct source references. Targets exclude the source SKU and source->requested-family mapping never depends on background, mode or seed. Same reference RGB+text+noise cannot have conflicting target supervision. This coverage is not proof of true one-input multimodal synthesis.
counterfactuals: TRAIN paired instruction variants share identical RGB and source-context noise across all tasks. DEV retains all8 original isolated products and16 reviewed views; same-family replacement is unavailable for a one-SKU DEV family, so DEV uses opposite-family requests with distinct reference contexts instead of no-op/duplicate targets. Audit actual distinct contexts and prompt-to-SKU counts, not sample count alone.
supervision: Genuine ABO alpha and white-unmatte foregrounds; exact changed-pixel masks are training/metric labels only, never forward inputs. Repeated generic instructions do not contain SKU, brand or full teacher descriptions. No new artificial component recoloring is introduced.
inference: Reference RGB+supplied short instruction only through full native Qwen. No target, mask, SKU, retrieval or reference-VAE input. The existing independent TEST540 remains sealed; this new data protocol requires separately frozen final evaluation before claims.
